title: Write to One Named Reader
label: ch:pa-a1-named-reader-message
canDo: I can choose and order already practised Gurmukhi chunks into an untimed independent 30–40-word message for one named reader, then check tone, meaning, agreement, spacing, spelling, and punctuation separately.

payoff.summary: The learner writes a no-model 30–40-word message to Manan for a stated purpose, independently selecting and ordering known chunks, then self-checks separate error dimensions without an exact-answer auto-grade.
